name: assign_joint_restraint
author: hprebar
title: Assign joint restraints (supports)
description: Assigns support boundary conditions to one or more points: fixed (all 6 DOFs), pinned (U1,U2,U3), roller (U3), free (all released), or custom (6 booleans). Writes the model: the bridge saves it and takes a .SDB snapshot first.
notes: OAPI: cPointObj.SetRestraint (DOFs: U1, U2, U3, R1, R2, R3).

restraints.description: 6 booleans [U1, U2, U3, R1, R2, R3] required when type is 'custom'
